sources.title: EgoVLA: Learning Vision-Language-Action Models from Egocentric Human Videos
sources.snippet: EgoVLA is a vision-language-action (VLA) model that combines the broad diversity of human egocentric videos with the precision of robot demonstrations. It is first pretrained on large-scale human manipulation data, learning to predict future hand and wrist motions from visual observations, language instructions, and proprioceptive signals.
